title: VP Quality, Compliance and Facilities
text:
At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
 
 
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
 
 
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or a related field.
* A minimum of 10–15 years (or more) of relevant experience in quality, compliance, and/or operations leadership in a high-volume manufacturing environment (Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, Automotive, or secure/payment products) , with at least 5-10 years experience in managing teams across multiple shift in a 24/7 environment :
* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience
* Very strong analytical skill set, including familiarity with quality and reliability tools (e.g., FMEA, SPC, Kaizen).
* Regulatory fluency:
* OSHA, EPA, ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety)
* Industrial hygiene and risk assessment methodologies
* Environmental compliance (emissions, waste management, hazmat handling)
* Process safety management
* Incident investigation and workers' compensation/claims oversight
* Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams required.
* Demonstrated experience in third party audits ( ISO , PCI, ....)
* Occasional travel to suppliers and partners.

**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**

* Quality certifications such as Black belt Six Sigma
* GHG Management
* Familiarity with ERP tools
* Experience in a secure payment, or otherwise highly regulated manufacturing environment.

**About CompoSecure**
CompoSecure, a GPGI business (NYSE: GPGI), is the leading manufacturer of Premium Metal Payment Cards and also offers best-in-class Authentication and Digital Asset solutions. The Company's offerings combine elegance, simplicity, and security to deliver exceptional experiences and peace of mind, enabling trust for millions of people around the globe. For more information, please visit
**www.CompoSecure.com**
and
**www.GetArculus.com**
.
 
 
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage; FSA/HSA options; company-paid life and disability insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off (PTO) and holidays; annual bonus opportunities; an employee assistance program (EAP); and opportunities for career growth and advancement.
 
 
*Additional details will be provided during the hiring process.*
CompoSecure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. We are also an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
 
 
**Please note:**
CompoSecure does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited resumes sent to CompoSecure, including to our employees, will become the property of CompoSecure and may be used without any obligation to pay referral or placement fees. Any agency or recruiter seeking to work with CompoSecure's Talent Acquisition Team should contact our team directly by sending an email to
**recruiting@composecure.com**
.
 
 
CompoSecure offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to work alongside a team of dedicated professionals who are shaping the future of financial technology.
